issue.title: Replace This week with a chat conversation composition
issue.description:
Replace the current "This week" gallery composition with a simple chat conversation composition built directly from shadcn's official Message component family.

Reference:

* Use the current official shadcn Message component/pattern as the implementation basis:
  [https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/message](<https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/message>)

Owner direction:

* Remove the existing "This week" composition from the Cards gallery.
* Replace it in the same general gallery slot with a chat/messaging composition.
* Use shadcn's Message component architecture directly rather than inventing a custom chat-message system.
* Prefer the official Message / MessageAvatar / MessageContent / MessageHeader / MessageFooter composition and Bubble for visible message surfaces where appropriate.
* Keep the result compact, polished, and suitable for the gallery.

Implementation basis:

* Follow the current shadcn Message API and composition.
* Use start/end alignment for sender/receiver rows.
* Use MessageAvatar where an avatar improves the composition.
* Use MessageGroup for consecutive messages from the same sender if useful.
* Use MessageHeader / MessageFooter only where they improve the gallery composition.
* Use Bubble / BubbleContent for message surfaces.
* Do not add MessageScroller unless the card genuinely needs scrolling; the goal is a small static showcase conversation, not a full chat application.

Creative freedom:

* The worker may choose the conversation copy, participant treatment, avatar usage, message count, alignment, and any lightweight metadata.
* Keep the composition visually balanced and simple rather than reproducing a specific screenshot pixel-for-pixel.

Interaction boundaries:

* Keep interaction minimal and geometry-stable.
* No dynamic message insertion, streaming, expanding threads, drawers, or workflow-heavy messaging logic.
* A static or lightweight input affordance is not required.
* Prefer the composition to function primarily as a visual design-system showcase.

Design-system constraints:

* Styling must remain driven by Personal UI semantic tokens.
* Use Heading / Body / Mono roles appropriately.
* Preserve light/dark mode behavior.
* Do not hard-code arbitrary colors when semantic tokens exist.
* Reuse existing Avatar/Button/etc. shadcn primitives as required by the official Message pattern.

Resource/registry:

* If Message, Bubble, or another required official shadcn primitive is not yet present in the project, audit the current shadcn implementation and add only the minimal official resources needed.
* Any new public resource must be genuinely reusable and reflected correctly in the registry/tests.
* Do not introduce a custom public chat primitive when the official shadcn component already covers the need.

Gallery/layout constraints:

* Preserve the accepted container-responsive Cards gallery architecture.
* Keep the replacement in the intended "This week" slot unless another admitted ticket changes ordering.
* Preserve coherent DOM/focus order and responsive containment.

Acceptance:

* "This week" no longer appears in the Cards gallery.
* A polished chat conversation composition replaces it in the intended position.
* The composition uses shadcn's official Message component family as its implementation basis.
* No custom parallel message architecture is introduced unnecessarily.
* The chat card remains responsive to Personal UI theme/token edits.
* Light/dark rendering is coherent.
* Interaction remains minimal and does not materially change card height.
* No overflow, focus-order, accessibility, or responsive regression.
* Any new shadcn public resources added are minimal, reusable, registered, and tested.

relatedTo.title: Simplify gallery card interactions and preserve stable geometry
